sources.snippet: OrcaRouter's abliterated Qwen3.8-27B, in MLX for Apple Silicon plus GGUF and FP8 — what abliteration did and the real hardware/safety tradeoffs.

sources.title: orcarouter/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B tensor-level abliterated, vision tower and MTP head untouched. 0% over-refusal on XSTest, 0-6% refusal across the A/B suite, no measurable capability loss. Full mmproj vision, tool calling and thinking, 262K context.

sources.title: README.md · orcarouter/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-GGUF at main
sources.snippet: GGUF conversions of Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored — an abliterated (refusal-removed) build of Qwen's Qwen3.8-27B, a 27B dense hybrid-attention (Gated DeltaNet linear + full attention) native vision-language model with reasoning, tool-calling, and an MTP speculative-decoding head. These files run in llama.cpp (CPU / CUDA / Metal / ROCm), quantized from 2-bit to 16-bit, with a separate mmproj file ...
